qa_pair.question: Among ComfyUI's bundled example workflows, find the category that contains the most examples. Every example in that category requires the same two checkpoint files. Give the exact filename of the one that is not the Stage C model.
Look across every bundled example workflow and count how many of them list each required node type. One node type is required by more examples than any other. How many examples require it?
Two bundled example workflows tie for requiring the largest number of model files, and they sit in two different categories. How many model files does each of them require?
Exactly one bundled prompting guide shares its name with an example-workflow category. Name that guide, and say how many example workflows its category contains.
Exactly one bundled example workflow belongs to the edit category. What is the exact filename of the checkpoint it requires?
Of all the bundled example workflows, how many list no required model downloads at all?
Three bundled example workflows require the unCLIPCheckpointLoader node. All three list the same single checkpoint. What is it called?
How many of the bundled model-specific prompting guides describe families that support prompt weights such as (keyword:1.2)?
How many example-workflow categories contain exactly one example each?
Exactly one bundled example workflow requires a VAE whose filename begins with "wan_2.1", and it is not a Wan workflow. What is that example called?
The bundled prompting guide for the Anima model family defines a prompt structure as an ordered list of slots. Fetch only that structure section. How many slots does it define?

Some bundled prompting guides define an explicit ordered prompt structure - a numbered list of slots to fill in order - while the rest only give prose guidance. How many of them define that ordered structure?
Of all the bundled prompting guides, how many describe model families whose prompting style is booru tags rather than natural language, keywords or a hybrid of the two?

With ComfyUI not running, the Danbooru tag search still answers from a smaller built-in vocabulary, and says which optional ComfyUI custom node would give it the full tag data. What is that node's repository name?

The tag-vocabulary section of a booru-style prompting guide names two tools for going beyond its curated tag list: one looks a tag up by substring, the other returns tags that commonly co-occur with the ones already in your prompt. What is the exact name of the second tool?
